name: Calm-regime range-floor reversion (15m)
rationale: Reversion at the channel floor works only when the regime is calm: pairing a low range_position with a low realized volatility on 15m isolates the quiet, oscillating tape where a dip to support is bought back, not the volatile tape where support fails. The other side is the seller pressing a support level that holds in a low-energy book. Edge persists because calm ranges are the natural habitat of grid/market-making bids. Distinct from the ADX-gated floor reversion: the regime filter here is realized-vol MAGNITUDE, not trend directionality — two different ways to define 'calm'. Disconfirmer: exits when range_position recovers toward the mid, or the stop fires if the floor breaks.
catalyst: price at channel floor in a low-volatility regime
